mcq.q: An e-commerce website uses an array-based list to store items in a user's shopping cart. The user removes an item from the cart. What happens internally

options.A: The element is removed, and all elements shift left
options.B: The element remains but is marked as "deleted"
options.C: A new cart array is created
options.D: The last item is removed instead

mcq.answer_text: The element is removed, and all elements shift left
